protocol.development_basis: Iterative FFT passed desktop parity but 5 MS/s nuisance-fit smoke still takes 114-120 ms CPU. Remove serial oscillator and accumulator dependencies while retaining the same FP64 whole-probe LS tone model.
protocol.scope: Optional blocked FP64 tone fit plus iterative FFT. No reduced support, new hypotheses, or changed thresholds. Final fractional GLRT uses tone-conditioned working IQ when applied; original input remains unchanged.
algorithm_changes: Use four independent FP64 accumulators for lag products and local tone correlations, with explicit tail handling.
Factor the LS sinusoid into a 256-sample local basis and one phase rotation per block; subtract the same fitted whole-probe tone.
Compare full candidate and nuisance outputs before interpreting ARM timing.
